insight: Markets a three-layer memory architecture (short/medium/long-term) and group chat with multiple companions at once, which most rivals lack.
name: Nomi
tagline: AI companions with layered long-term memory and multi-companion group chat.
description: Nomi builds AI companions emphasizing strong, layered memory across short-, medium-, and long-term context. A single subscription supports multiple companions and a group-chat mode where several interact with you at once; paid tiers add unlimited voice calls and daily AI image generation.
